# Scott Robertson

Scott Robertson is a designer who designed cars for Hot Wheels in 2005; he did not actually work for Mattel during that time however. Robertson is an educator on the side, teaching initially at the Art Center College of Design from 1995 to 2010 and then from his own company, Scott Robertson Design LLC. He authored the book How To Draw Cars The Hot Wheels Way with assistance from the Hot Wheels design team.
